title: Fraction word problems
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Choose and explain a fraction operation from a situation.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: Read for the whole, the equal parts, and what changes. A quick drawing helps you decide whether to add, subtract, compare, or find a fraction of a quantity.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

sections.problem: Maya drank 1/4 litre in the morning and 2/4 litre later. How much did she drink?
steps: Both amounts use fourths, so the pieces match.
Keep the denominator 4 and include the unit.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: Answer the question with a number, fraction, and unit when one is given.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: Sam used 2/6 metre of ribbon, then 1/6 metre. How much altogether?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
